subject: MAP milestone: Load test coordination & proposed windows
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP milestone: Load test coordination & proposed windows

Hi Sam — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and concrete asks so we can lock the MAP milestone (Load/Perf test):

What we heard on the call:
- Peak observed QPS: ~12k sustained (2-minute bursts up to ~18k) across read-only inference paths
- Traffic distribution: 70% short prompts (<128 tokens), 30% long-context (>=512 tokens)
- Primary objective: validate latency SLO (p95 < 120ms) under peak traffic and confirm capacity sizing for Dedicated vs Hosted fallback

Proposed MAP milestone items (what we want signoff on):
1) Test window options (pick preferred):
   - Option A: Tue 2027-06-08 01:00–05:00 UTC (off-peak for Acme)
   - Option B: Thu 2027-06-10 22:00–02:00 UTC (engineering preferred)
2) Traffic replay artifact: you to provide anonymized sample logs (we received a small sample; full replay artifact needed)
3) Sizing target: Redwood to propose Dedicated GPU pool (config + cost delta) for validation run; fallback: Hosted with autoscale policy
4) Ownership: Acme provides replay logs and a contact for procurement; Redwood provides runbook, infra leads, and SE support during window
5) Target close for this MAP milestone: 2027-06-15 (date we aim to finalize capacity / acceptance criteria)

Attachments: acme_map_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), traffic_profile_v2.json (sample profile)

Next steps / asks for you: please confirm (A) which test window you prefer, (B) who at Acme will upload the full replay artifact and (C) confirm peak QPS numbers above or provide corrected figures by EOD Tue.

If we get a confirmation today we’ll: schedule the run, lock a Dedicated pool tentative hold, and create the runbook with contact ops on-call.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachments: acme_map_v1.xlsx (15KB), traffic_profile_v2.json (48KB)

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme-corp.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T13:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP milestone: Load test coordination & proposed windows

Evelyn — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the numbers from our side:
- Sustained peak QPS: 11,500–12,300 (averages vary by region)
- Short vs long split: matches your note (roughly 70/30)

We can provide the full anonymized replay artifact. Lina (procurement) will coordinate uploads to the shared S3 (or Drive) bucket — Lina, can you confirm by EOD tomorrow?

Preferred window: Option A (Tue 2027-06-08 01:00–05:00 UTC) works best for our ops team.

Two notes / asks from Acme:
1) Warm-up requirement: we will need a 30-minute warm-up/seeding period before the official window to populate KV caches.
2) Data retention: logs from the test must be retained for 30 days for our internal audit — please confirm Redwood’s retention policy for test artifacts (we prefer it be deleted after 30 days).

I attached a small sample of our recent request logs for profile verification (sample_http_logs.tar.gz).

Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Platform Ops, Acme Corp
sam.patel@acme-corp.com

Attachments: sample_http_logs.tar.gz (2.2MB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme-corp.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-31T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP milestone: Load test coordination & proposed windows

Thanks Sam — good detail. Quick sizing and run plan from SE perspective: helpful notes below.

Sizing recommendation (initial):
- Dedicated: 4x A800-class GPUs in a single pool with continuous batching enabled + prefix cache; estimated steady cost delta ~ $5.2k for the run window (includes warm-up). Expected p95 ~ 90–110ms for 70/30 mix.
- Hosted fallback: autoscaled 6x smaller instances (quantized model) with a slight latency penalty (p95 ~ 140–160ms under peak, risk of throttling during 2-min bursts)

Run plan highlights:
- 30-minute warm-up (agree with Sam), then 3 x 40-minute sustained sections emulating your burst pattern (2 minutes high burst, 18 minutes steady)
- KV cache population script will be provided; we need your anonymized replay artifact uploaded to the Drive link Evelyn referenced by 2027-06-03 23:59 UTC to allow us a day for prep
- We’ll instrument tracing for token-level latency, host CPU temp, and queue depth; will share dashboards in real time

Dependencies for success:
- Procurement: temporary Dedicated hold (ops to provision) — Lina to confirm PO timeline
- Network: ensure no egress throttles between Acme test agents and Redwood region (we’ll send a small network test script)
- Legal: one-off test NDA for replay artifacts if data contains sensitive headers (Ben to send template)

I’ll draft a short runbook and add the specific SE/infra on-call names — target to circulate the runbook by 2027-06-04.

If Acme is comfortable with Dedicated, we’ll provision a hold and publish cost delta in the MAP. Otherwise, we’ll define acceptance criteria for Hosted fallback and run a narrower SLA smoke test first.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

--
References: internal sizing note: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aBcDfE-map-draft

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-06-01T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP milestone: Load test coordination & proposed windows

Folks — adding a short orchestration note and proposed ownership for the MAP milestone so this is actionable in our mutual action plan: 

MAP milestone: Load/perf validation (target close 2027-06-15)
- Owner (Redwood): Evelyn Hart — run scheduling, runbook owner, liaison to SE/infra
- Owner (Redwood SE): Ben Carter — sizing, run execution support, dashboards
- Owner (Acme): Sam Patel — replay artifact upload, ops on-call during test, procurement contact: Lina Gomez
- Target test window: 2027-06-08 01:00–05:00 UTC (Option A confirmed by Acme)
- Prep deadlines: upload replay artifact by 2027-06-03 23:59 UTC; runbook circulated by 2027-06-04 17:00 UTC; hold tentative Dedicated pool by 2027-06-06
- Acceptance criteria: p95 latency < 120ms and no request-level errors above 0.1% sustained

Operational asks: please confirm the PO lead and whether Acme will approve a temporary Dedicated hold (non-billable until go/no-go) — Lina, can you confirm procurement timeline?

I’ll create the MAP milestone card in HubSpot and link it here when done.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Product Manager, Redwood Inference
